fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the structure without obstruction.
• Trim vegetation along the sides of the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles traveling to the structure.
• Cut back plants and shrubs growing close to the structure so responders can move along the exterior walls without obstruction.
• Designate a flat, open area on the property where emergency vehicles can turn around or reposition without backing long distances down the access drive.
• Keep the front entry area clear of stored items, vehicles, and overgrown plants so responders can reach the door quickly.
• Mark or identify any secondary foot paths across the lawn area that responders could use to reach the sides or rear of the structure on foot.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim back shrubs that are growing directly against or within a few feet of the house walls.
• Thin scattered shrubs around the structure to create open gaps between individual plants and the house.
• Remove or cut back grass cover close to the house, especially where it runs up to the foundation or walls.
• Separate shrub clusters near the structure so they are not touching or overlapping each other.
• Trim low branches on scattered trees near the house so they do not connect to nearby shrubs below them.
• Keep the driveway clear of overhanging branches along its full length so vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Cut grass along both sides of the driveway to keep it passable and visible.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to find from the main road, especially under smoky conditions.
• Thin shrubs and vegetation along the driveway edges so a vehicle can pull through without vegetation pressing against its sides.
• Remove dead or dry grass and plant material from the area immediately surrounding the structure.
• Create a visible open gap between the outermost shrubs and the walls of the house on all sides.
• Keep the area directly under scattered trees near the house clear of shrubs and tall grass growing beneath them.
